page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage or dedicated GPU hardware is bundled with this instance, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a solid mid-tier profile for multi-core and memory operations. The instance achieves average ratings in stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Passmark CPU scores, and memory bandwidth tests, with read-only cached memory bandwidth reaching 389.72 GB/sec. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by bottom-quartile results in stress-ng single-core tests, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression. Database operations and Redis SET operations perform at an average level, processing 6.4 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g6.2xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for standard enterprise workloads without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-core capabilities, it is best suited for general-purpose applications, software compilation, text processing, and moderate database workloads. It is less optimal for high-throughput static web serving or single-threaded compression tasks due to its lower single-core performance characteristics.
